reply:
{
  "title": "The 60-Day Soviet Intent Estimate",
  "setting": "Washington, 15 March 1948, Intelligence Advisory Committee",
  "decider": "The Intelligence Advisory Committee",
  "agent_recast": false,
  "recast_note": "",
  "agent": "The Intelligence Advisory Committee",
  "agent_role": "decide",
  "situation": "During a crisis over Berlin, reports and a cable from the U.S. military governor in Germany prompted concern in Washington. European intelligence officers assessed that further Soviet measures short of war were likely, but that war was unlikely. Army and Air Force intelligence presented more dire assessments, while the Army's estimate acknowledged a lack of conclusive evidence of an immediate Soviet intention to initiate hostilities. The ad hoc committee's members had disagreed over whether to state directly that war was unlikely, and its estimate that war was improbable for at least 60 days was not accepted by the Intelligence Advisory Committee. The President requested definitive yes-or-no answers that morning about Soviet intent to provoke war within 30 days, 60 days, and during 1948.",
  "question": "What should the Intelligence Advisory Committee do in response to the President's request for an estimate of Soviet intent to provoke war?",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "kind": "intelligence",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "European intelligence officers assessed that further Soviet measures short of war were likely, but war was unlikely.",
      "spans": ["src:559101d4874b#p36.3"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "kind": "intelligence",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "Army and Air Force intelligence reached dire conclusions; the Army's estimate described Soviet forces as overshadowing Europe and most of Asia and U.S. forces as unable to prevent a Soviet advance across most of Eurasia.",
      "spans": ["src:559101d4874b#p36.5", "src:559101d4874b#p37.2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "kind": "intelligence",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "The Army's estimate acknowledged that it lacked conclusive evidence of an immediate Soviet intention to initiate hostilities.",
      "spans": ["src:559101d4874b#p37.2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "kind": "intelligence",
      "status": "assessed",
      "fact": "No intelligence organization argued that war was likely or imminent, but Army G-2 and Air Force Intelligence would not agree to state directly that war was unlikely.",
      "spans": ["src:559101d4874b#p37.2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Army leadership treated the crisis cable as support for increased budget funding, and Army G-2 sought to include universal military training in the estimate.",
      "spans": ["src:559101d4874b#p36.5", "src:559101d4874b#p37.2"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The service chiefs had decided to request a supplemental budget and rejected the ad hoc committee's draft; the Director of Naval Intelligence supported the estimate.",
      "spans": ["src:559101d4874b#p37.3"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The President requested definitive yes-or-no answers that morning about whether the Soviets would deliberately provoke war within 30 days, within 60 days, and during 1948.",
      "spans": ["src:559101d4874b#p37.4", "src:559101d4874b#p38.2", "src:559101d4874b#p38.3", "src:559101d4874b#p38.4"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Intelligence Advisory Committee did not agree to the ad hoc committee's estimate, and after debate it consolidated the first two questions while deferring the question about 1948.",
      "spans": ["src:559101d4874b#p37.4", "src:559101d4874b#p38.5"]
    }
  ],
  "options": {
    "O1": {
      "do": "The Intelligence Advisory Committee approves and issues an estimate stating that no reliable evidence indicates Soviet intent to use military action within 60 days and that such action is not expected.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "approve",
      "irreversible": false
    },
    "O2": {
      "do": "The Intelligence Advisory Committee rejects that estimate and issues an estimate stating that evidence indicates Soviet intent to use military action within 60 days and that such action is expected.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "reject",
      "irreversible": false
    }
  },
  "opposite_pair": ["O1", "O2"],
  "no_opposite_reason": "",
  "real_option": "O1",
  "authored_options": ["O2"]
}
